row.title: A backup job names its account; it never inherits the workflow's
row.body: The first backup drill (2026-11-20) used the workflow secret CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, which points at the Quniverse account, and backed up its personal and other-project databases into its ultrastable-git bucket. The 13 copies were deleted. doctrine/backup.json now pins account_id to the topology account, a test asserts it, and the count query is chunked to D1's compound-select limit (chunks of 40 failed with HTTP 400 on every database of more than 5 tables).
